<thought>To find a suitable single-step retrosynthetic disconnection, I will search the template catalog for a reaction that, in the forward direction, is a carbonyl‑ene reaction (i.e., it forms a C–O bond (hydroxyl) and a five‑membered ring while breaking a C=O (ketone) and a C=C bond). The reverse of that reaction will give the desired precursors. I will query the catalog for templates that break a ketone and a C=C bond and form a hydroxyl and a five‑membered ring.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "[CH2:1]=[C:2]([c:3]1[cH:4][cH:5][cH:6][cH:7][cH:8]1)[C@@H:9]1[CH2:10][CH2:11][CH2:12][C@@:13]1([OH:14])[C:15]([F:16])([F:17])[F:18]",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["ketone", "C=C"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["hydroxyl", "five-membered ring"],
  "limit": 5
}
